profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: Excited about new possibilities in my career path. Over 13 years of experience, eager to continue to learn and grow. Wide repertoire, specializes in PHP, MySQL, Angular and AWS.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Worked extensively creating and modifying API calls and endpoints to facilitate communication between applications.

- Created new features for the application involving work with both AngularJS and PHP.

- Restructured massive UI to maximize UX and improve visual design using PHP, HTML, SCSS, JavaScript and jQuery; creating a Flex responsive layout from an outdated adaptive application.

- Expanded and modified AngularJS POS application to update look and increase functionality.

- Worked closely with a small team, using Agile Methodology to localize and upgrade a large enterprise application (site builder, admin golf course management interface and connected POS application) from a European configuration to a North American Locale.

- Helped to bring a lagging project up to date and work on a tight schedule to present at a nationally recognized tradeshow.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Software Infrastructure · Containerization · User Interface · AngularJS

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed large scale software solutions using Angular and PHP to create hybrid web applications.

- Created and managed a wide range of Amazon Web Services (AWS) components, for both Unix and  Windows servers. Developed skills as an Agile Project Manager on large custom projects.

- Upgraded several projects to modern systems and servers, including IP transfer.

- Worked daily in Angular and PHP to create and manage the company’s internal web system.

- Managed company servers in AWS, EC2 and beyond.

- Led an Angular project to create a financial investment web application.

- Worked as a solo developer for 3+ years maintaining and managing the internal web application for the company, written with an Angular, TypeScript Front End and a PHP Yii2 Framework backend.

- Worked closely with clients to maximize their projects and reach their goals

- Produced UI/UX mockups and implemented them into existing web applications
